failing.summary: commands/launch.md:112-114,122-124; commands/reserve.md:82-85 (raised by opus as its dc-05): INCOMPLETE. Both pages describe the release hold as binding the implement loop's land step only. launch.md says 'every other session's land step (an `implement step` arming a merge ...) refuses to arm' and 'The hold binds abcd's own land step'. reserve.md says 'an `implement step` at the land fence in any other copy ... exits 3'. In the code, `abcd land` is held too: internal/core/landing/releasehold.go:11-29 calls claim.FetchMergeHold. commands/land.md documents 'While a release is being cut, exit 3', and the changelog line names both 'the implement loop's land fence and `abcd land`'. Fix: name `abcd land` beside `implement step` in both places.

failing.summary: README.md:69; commands/announce.md (raised by opus as its dc-06): INCOMPLETE. The README says '`abcd status` needs git 2.29 or later, which reads a fetch's branches from its standard input (`git fetch --stdin`)'. `abcd announce` fetches the status branches by name through the same path: internal/core/claim/announce.go:95-96 sets ns.only and calls fetchWith, and remote.go:765-766 switches to `fetch --stdin` whenever a namespace has ns.only. So announce needs git 2.29 too once origin holds any status branch, and on an older git it refuses with an error that names 'the status fetch'. commands/announce.md does not mention the requirement. Fix: 'abcd status and abcd announce need git 2.29 or later ...' in the README, plus a line in announce.md.
